title: Circuit Breaker
description: Implement a circuit breaker pattern that opens after upstream failures and recovers after a cooldown period.

steps.title: Proxy to upstream
steps.description: Create GET /proxy that forwards requests to an upstream service at http://localhost:3001/upstream and returns the result 200 if healthy.
hints: Use a reverse proxy: forward incoming request to upstream
Start the upstream service on port 3001 with a /upstream endpoint

steps.title: Circuit opens on failures
steps.description: Track upstream failures. After 3 consecutive failures, the circuit opens and returns 503 without calling upstream.

steps.title: Circuit status endpoint
steps.description: Create GET /circuit/status that returns the current circuit breaker state: OPEN, CLOSED, or HALF_OPEN.
hints: Track the circuit state as a string: 'CLOSED', 'OPEN', or 'HALF_OPEN'
CLOSED when below threshold, OPEN when exceeded
Return { state: '...' } from the status endpoint

steps.title: Half-open and recovery
steps.description: After a cooldown period, the circuit transitions to HALF_OPEN. If the upstream recovers, the circuit closes; otherwise it reopens.
hints: Add a cooldown timer when circuit opens
After cooldown, set state to HALF_OPEN
In HALF_OPEN, allow one request through; success = CLOSED, failure = OPEN
